synthesizedFacts.fact: Retinoid creams, derived from vitamin A, may improve the appearance of stretch marks that are less than a few months old by rebuilding collagen.
Retinoid creams can irritate the skin and should be used with caution, especially during pregnancy or nursing.
There is no strong evidence supporting the effectiveness of creams, oils, or lotions in preventing or treating stretch marks.
